description: Adonis Creed faces his toughest challenge yet when he steps into the ring against Viktor Drago, the son of the man who killed his father. With Rocky by his side, it’s a fight for pride, legacy, and redemption. VJ Junior turns every punch and every roar of the crowd into pure excitement—this is boxing with heart, power, and passion!
